prerequisites: Second study section achieved (at least 42 ECTS points from the first study section must be demonstrated)
Basic knowledge in propositional and predicate logic (reading formulas), specifying and modeling simple facts with the help of formulas

learning_outcomes.text: Recognize and understand the utility and applications of knowledge-based systems, and how this field relates to or is distinct from other core areas of computer science.
Name the classical methods for representing, eliciting, and machine processing of human knowledge as the foundation of Artificial Intelligence.
Apply these classical methods practically using a common AI programming language, focusing on economically viable technologies such as expert systems and learning classifiers.
Methodically solve selected logical problems using a logical programming language.
Methodically solve selected topological game problems without computer support, if these can be examined with hand copies.
Model and solve selected topological game problems using a logical programming language or a SAT solver.

syllabus_topics: Problem Solving with Graphs: Application to Game Problems
Constraint Satisfaction Problems and Constraint Logic Programming
Knowledge Representation: Logic, Inference, Rule-based and Expert Systems
Fundamentals of Pattern Recognition (Bayes, Classification, Loss Matrix, DTW)
assessment_rules: The assessment is a 90-minute written examination.
